newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise June rubber futures margin fee.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise June rubber futures margin fee.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday it was raising the margin requirement on its June rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Wednesday.
The increase will bring the total June rubber futures margin fee to 87,750 yen, while the requirements on other rubber futures will remain unchanged at 52,500 yen.
The move is intended to cool overheated trade, TOCOM said in a statement.
